name: Your GHL and Pipedrive, Connected: Leads Routed, Stages Synced

parameters.content:
## Your GHL and Pipedrive, Connected: Leads Routed, Stages Synced

### How it works
- A new lead or a stage change in GHL sends one webhook to n8n.
- The record is cleaned, then Pipedrive is searched by email so nobody is created twice.
- Lead source picks the owner, and the deal lands in the matching pipeline stage.
- A stage move in Pipedrive moves the GHL opportunity, so your GHL follow-up workflows fire.
- Each move books the owner's next call in Pipedrive, and the sync ignores its own echo.

### Setup
- GHL: one workflow on Opportunity Created and Stage Changed with a Webhook step to URL 1.
- Pipedrive: a deal change webhook to URL 2, plus three deal custom fields for the GHL ids and lead source.
- Lead sources, owners and stages are mapped once, in steps 4 and 10.
- Existing contacts and opportunities migrate through the same cleaner and dedupe.
- Every path tested with test leads before launch, then a written runbook and a training call.

### What I need from you
- Your lead sources and which rep owns each one.
- Your GHL stages and the Pipedrive stage each one matches.
- A GHL private integration token and location id, and a Pipedrive API token.
- Where the failure alert should go.

nodes.name: Overview

parameters.content:
## 1 - CUSTOM FIELDS, TAGS AND LEAD SOURCES

Your part on custom fields, tags and lead sources, with the CRM data quality you asked for. Names, phone format and lead source are cleaned, and Pipedrive is searched by email before anyone is created.

nodes.name: Section - 1 - CUSTOM FIELDS, TAGS AND LEAD SOURCES

parameters.content:
## 2 - LEAD ASSIGNMENT AND ROUTING

Lead source decides which rep owns the lead and which stage the deal opens in. A person already in Pipedrive stays with their rep.

nodes.name: Section - 2 - LEAD ASSIGNMENT AND ROUTING

parameters.content:
## 3 - CONNECT GHL AND PIPEDRIVE

One person and one deal per lead in Pipedrive, linked both ways. The Pipedrive deal id goes back onto the GHL contact, and the clean record replaces the messy one.

nodes.name: Section - 3 - CONNECT GHL AND PIPEDRIVE

parameters.content:
## 4 - MIGRATE EXISTING CONTACTS AND OPPORTUNITIES

Run once before launch. Your existing GHL opportunities and their contacts go through the same cleaner, dedupe and routing as a new lead.

nodes.name: Section - 4 - MIGRATE EXISTING CONTACTS AND OPPORTUNITIES

parameters.content:
## 5 - PIPELINE MOVEMENT AND ACTIVITY AUTOMATION

When a rep moves a deal in Pipedrive, the GHL opportunity moves to the same stage and your GHL follow-up workflows fire. The rep's next call is booked on the deal.

nodes.name: Section - 5 - PIPELINE MOVEMENT AND ACTIVITY AUTOMATION

parameters.content:
## 6 - IF A STEP FAILS

Any failure emails you the step that stopped and a link to the run, so you can fix it and retry.
